name: @learning-hub/api-contract
description: Central API contract for Learning Hub (OpenAPI + generated types + scenarios)

scripts.generate: npm run generate:frontend && npm run generate:e2e && npm run generate:backend
scripts.generate:backend: cd ../backend && mkdir -p contract && go run github.com/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen/v2/cmd/oapi-codegen@v2.6.0 -generate types -package contract ../api-contract/openapi/openapi.yaml > contract/types.gen.go && gofmt -w contract/types.gen.go
